All quantitative figures reported—such as national/urban/rural water and sanitation coverage percentages (Tables 2–3), sector budget shares (Table 4), and mean production cost versus tariff per litre—are purely descriptive secondary statistics with zero inferential hypothesis tests, regressions, standard errors, confidence intervals, or p-values.
